anchors.title: Sovereign Hill
anchors.description: Living-history gold rush museum — costumed staff, working gold mines, the Red Hill panning creek and the nightly AURA sound-and-light show. Allow a full day.

anchors.title: Art Gallery of Ballarat
anchors.description: Australia's oldest and largest regional gallery, established 1884. Houses the original Eureka Flag, plus major works by McCubbin, Streeton and contemporary Indigenous artists. Free entry.

anchors.title: Lake Wendouree Promenade
anchors.description: 6km walking and cycling loop around the lake at the western edge of the city. Picnic at the Botanical Gardens, hire a row boat, or sit at the Olympic Stand from the 1956 Games.

anchors.title: Eureka Centre Ballarat
anchors.description: Free museum on the site of the 1854 Eureka Rebellion — Australia's only armed civil uprising and the birthplace of Australian democracy. The original Eureka Flag is displayed nearby at the Art Gallery.

anchors.title: Kryal Castle
anchors.description: Medieval-themed castle outside Ballarat — jousting tournaments, the dragon's labyrinth and weekend feasts in the Great Hall. Family-favourite day trip.

SATURDAY.title: Ballarat Farmers Market
SATURDAY.description: Every Saturday morning at the Mining Exchange. 40+ growers and producers from across the Central Highlands. 8:30am-12:30pm.
